A noteworthy point is that the γ′ coarsening rates of the above H/MEAs all consistently follow the matrix-diffusion control kinetics mechanism (i.e., t1/3-law), without the competitive transition like in Ni-base superalloys.

Lu et al. [156] also found the similar competitive transition of coarsening kinetics mechanisms from matrix-diffusion control to trans-interface-diffusion control in both the Re-free and Re-containing Ni-base superalloys.
